pages.title: Who to ask, and how
pages.note: Requirements vary a lot by school, so check each school's letter rules (MSAR lists them) before you finalize who you ask. AMCAS details below are from the AAMC's 2027 AMCAS Applicant Guide; confirm them for your cycle.

items: Look up each school's letter rules in MSAR
Ask your prehealth office about a committee letter
Note any school that wants a physician or research letter
List the 3-5 writers that cover most of your schools
Science professors who saw your work up close
A non-science professor who knows how you think
A supervisor from clinical work or research
Someone who can share a specific story about you
A warm, detailed letter beats a famous name
Ask in person, at office hours, or in a kind email
Ask if they can write a strong letter for you
Make it easy for them to say no
Ask 6-8 weeks before you need it
Ask early in the year, before summer travel
Go to office hours more than once
Keep a few notes on projects you did with them
Save graded work they might want to look back at

sections.h: If your college has a committee
items: Find the committee's own deadlines (often spring)
Ask what they need from you: forms, essays, an interview
Ask which writers they want letters from
Put their deadlines on your calendar now
Your CV or activity list
A short note: what you did with them, 2-3 points
Why medicine, in a few sentences
Your deadline (a few weeks before you need it)
How to submit (AMCAS Letter Request Form)
Up to 10 letter entries in total
One entry each: committee, packet or individual
Writers upload via the Letter Writer Portal or Interfolio
Assign letters to schools after adding schools
Gentle reminder about a week before the deadline
Thank-you note once the letter is in
Share good news with them later!

sections.h: If a letter is running late
items: Check the letter's status in your AMCAS application
Send one more short, friendly note
Ask your prehealth office for advice
Keep a backup writer in mind
Letters must be resubmitted each cycle
Consider one new, recent letter

pins.headline: How to ask for med school letters
items: Check each school's letter rules
Pick people who know your work
Ask 6-8 weeks ahead
Send a CV + 2-3 points to mention
Follow up kindly, then say thank you
